decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line has had no web presence since 2019 and, as a multi-model niche line, its option value has likely resolved downward while carrying costs are relatively high, so real options reasoning favors dropping it.

The cleansing foam is a low-cost extension of the core Sandorini series whose demand uncertainty is still unresolved and the firm holds few other options, so the option value exceeds carrying costs and it should be kept.
